measurement.stabilityPolicy: Wait until every visible text region is unchanged for 150ms before whole-frame OCR. Background animation and recognized cursor/wait-arrow pixels do not reset text stability. Timing includes stability wait; pixel stability does not prove sentence completion.

constructedLoad: Replay window caption refresh requested every 16ms to exercise continuous WGC frame delivery while each game screenshot is exposed at least 500ms, including a deliberate 150ms text-stability wait; not real continuous gameplay.
